node.statement: Since rho_Upsilon' <= rho_T, lem-routef-raw-factor-norms gives ||tilde-Upsilon||_cb <= 1+C_T*eta. From (1.1), C_T=C_theta+3*C_V and rho_T <= min{[4*(1+C_theta)]^(-1),[4*(1+C_V)]^(-1)}, so C_theta*eta <= 1/4 and C_V*eta <= 1/4; thus C_T*eta <= 1 and ||tilde-Upsilon||_cb <= 2.
